description: This file contains helper builders for constructing Kubernetes RBAC policy rules, cluster role bindings, and role bindings in code, with validation and fluent interface methods.

classes.name: PolicyRuleBuilder
classes.description: Builder for constructing and validating Kubernetes PolicyRule objects.

classes.name: ClusterRoleBindingBuilder
classes.description: Builder for constructing and validating ClusterRoleBinding objects.

classes.name: RoleBindingBuilder
classes.description: Builder for constructing and validating RoleBinding objects.

methods.name: NewRule
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyRuleBuilder with specified verbs.

methods.name: PolicyRuleBuilder.Groups
methods.description: Adds API groups to the policy rule.

methods.name: PolicyRuleBuilder.Resources
methods.description: Adds resources to the policy rule.

methods.name: PolicyRuleBuilder.Names
methods.description: Adds resource names to the policy rule.

methods.name: PolicyRuleBuilder.URLs
methods.description: Adds non-resource URLs to the policy rule.

methods.name: PolicyRuleBuilder.RuleOrDie
methods.description: Returns the constructed PolicyRule or panics if invalid.

methods.name: PolicyRuleBuilder.Rule
methods.description: Validates and returns the constructed PolicyRule.

methods.name: NewClusterBinding
methods.description: Creates a new ClusterRoleBindingBuilder with specified cluster role name.

methods.name: ClusterRoleBindingBuilder.Groups
methods.description: Adds groups as subjects to the cluster role binding.

methods.name: ClusterRoleBindingBuilder.Users
methods.description: Adds users as subjects to the cluster role binding.

methods.name: ClusterRoleBindingBuilder.SAs
methods.description: Adds service accounts as subjects to the cluster role binding.

methods.name: ClusterRoleBindingBuilder.BindingOrDie
methods.description: Returns the ClusterRoleBinding or panics if invalid.

methods.name: NewRoleBinding
methods.description: Creates a new RoleBindingBuilder with specified role name and namespace.

methods.name: RoleBindingBuilder.Groups
methods.description: Adds groups as subjects to the role binding.

methods.name: RoleBindingBuilder.Users
methods.description: Adds users as subjects to the role binding.

methods.name: RoleBindingBuilder.SAs
methods.description: Adds service accounts as subjects to the role binding.

methods.name: RoleBindingBuilder.BindingOrDie
methods.description: Returns the RoleBinding or panics if invalid.
